description: Dual G_inject_A activation: mass-norm coupling in dim 0, kappa coupling in dim 3. Activates primary Omega_AC arccos path.

g_inject.G_inject_A_dim_7: 0.0  [disabled in EXP-315; was EXP-311/312/313/314 sole channel]
g_inject.rationale: Orthogonal injection: dim 0 = mass-geometry rate, dim 3 = kappa rate. v_A = J_AC @ S_A[0:4] acquires signal in dims 0 and 3. cos(Omega_AC) = S_A[3] / sqrt(S_A[0]^2 + S_A[3]^2) = f(mass_norm/kappa ratio).

omega_ac.path: primary (||v_A|| >= NUMERIC_FLOOR = 1e-6 guaranteed by dual G_inject)
omega_ac.fallback: 2 * arctan2(||S_C||, ||S_A||)  [not expected to activate with dual G_inject]

p_yz_invariance.G_inject_A_dim_0: ||Z_before[0:4]|| = ||sum(Sector A stalks)|| -- P_yz-invariant (Sector A dims unchanged under x-reflection)
p_yz_invariance.S_A_0_and_3: Both accumulate P_yz-invariant quantities -> S_A[0], S_A[3] P_yz-invariant
p_yz_invariance.v_A: J_AC @ S_A[0:4] = S_A[0:4]; S_A[0] and S_A[3] invariant, S_A[1]/S_A[2] ~ 0
p_yz_invariance.tau_opt: deterministic function of Omega_AC -> P_yz-invariant QED

expected_behavior.tau_opt_range: non-constant across partition depth (varies with kappa aggregate)
